linkedin.title: Most people feel overwhelmed by the news because they are reading the wrong things.
linkedin.body:
It is not that there is too much news out there. The problem is that the news we see is rarely relevant to our actual lives. We scroll through global headlines, breaking scandals, and updates on topics we do not care about, hoping to find one nugget of information that helps us understand the world better. This is an inefficient way to stay informed.

True information literacy is about signal, not volume. When you filter out the noise that does not apply to your career, your interests, or your community, the picture becomes much clearer. You stop reading just to keep up and start reading to learn.

We built Headlinne to solve this. By using AI to curate content that actually matters to you, we help you cut through the clutter. You get the depth you need without the fatigue that comes from doomscrolling through irrelevant updates.

Information is only valuable if it is useful to you. When you control the feed, you control your focus.

story_card.headline: Celine Dion returns to the stage in Paris
story_card.standfirst: The music icon is performing her first sold-out concerts since a major health diagnosis.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Celine Dion is back in Paris for a series of sold-out concerts. Fans are calling it the City of Celine.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: She took a long break after revealing in 2022 that she suffers from stiff-person syndrome.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: This tour marks her emotional comeback to live music after managing a complex health condition.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for updates on how these performances are received by her fans throughout the tour.

story_card.caption:
Celine Dion has officially returned to the stage in Paris for a series of sold-out shows.

This comeback is significant because it is her first tour since she publicly shared her diagnosis of stiff-person syndrome in 2022. The city has fully embraced the singer as she begins this new chapter.
